source: Game files 19.17020 (techtree.xml tech VillagerNorseToBerserk <cost>, <researchpoints>0; proto_unit_commands.xml VillagerNorseToBerserk; unit_transform.xml VillagerNorse->Berserk; proto.xml VillagerNorse <command>/<transformcommand>; techtree.xml ArchaicAgeNorse TechStatus active VillagerNorseToBerserk; ArchaicAgeLoki Cost x0.5)
notes: Per unit, instant (researchpoints 0), techtype ResearchableCommand, <transformvillager/>. Available from the Archaic Age for every Norse god. Gatherer (pop 1) becomes a Berserk (pop 2); whether a free pop slot is required is not in the files. The Berserk cannot gather (no Gather protoaction) but builds every building except Farm and Ox Cart. Already in norse.json as unit.promotion.

effects.note: ArchaicAgeLoki: OxCartBuilding food/wood x0.5 BasePercent (and OxCart x0.5 Percent) -> 20 food + 20 wood.

source: Game files 19.17020 (proto.xml OxCartBuilding <buildreplacement>OxCart, <cost>, <buildpoints>15; proto.xml OxCart unittype FoodDropsite/WoodDropsite/GoldDropsite/LogicalTypeConvertsHerds, <tech> list, no populationcount; proto.xml VillagerNorse/VillagerDwarf <train>OxCartBuilding, Build rate OxCartBuilding 1.0)
notes: A Gatherer/Dwarf places an OxCartBuilding foundation (immobile, 15 build points = 15 s for one builder at rate 1.0; Cancel Building is its only command); when finished it is replaced by the OxCart unit. The cart is a dropsite for food, wood and gold (not favor: only Town/Village Centers are FavorDropsite), claims herdables (LogicalTypeConvertsHerds) and researches Husbandry, Plow, Irrigation, Flood Control, Hunting Equipment, Hand Axe, Bow Saw, Carpenters, Pickaxe, Shaft Mine, Quarry, Winter Harvest. 0 population, no build limit. Infantry/heroes cannot place it (OxCartBuilding not in their <train> lists). Loki -50%.

source: Game files 19.17020 (proto.xml OxCart <maxvelocity>3.8, <command>SeekShelter, tactics ox_cart.tactics; tactics/ox_cart.tactics action Gather maxrange 2, donotdepositresources 1)
notes: No pack/unpack: the OxCart is an ordinary land unit that works as a dropsite wherever it stands. Move it like any unit; right-clicking a resource sends it to within 2 m of it (Gather tactic with Idle anim, deposits nothing). Its only extra command is Seek Shelter. Relocation cost = travel time at 3.8 m/s.

source: Game files 19.17020 (proto.xml VillagerNorse and VillagerDwarf <train> House/OxCartBuilding/Farm, Build protoaction rate Farm/House/OxCartBuilding 1.0, Repair rate House 0.4)
notes: Gatherers and Dwarves (identical lists) can only build House, Farm (enabled in Classical by ClassicalAgeNorse) and Ox Cart, and only repair Houses.

effects.note: ArchaicAgeLoki: Build WorkRate x1.1 BasePercent vs unittype Building for AbstractInfantry (Berserk, Hirdman, Throwing Axeman, Huskarl, Hersir) and Godi. Applies to Houses they build too.

source: Game files 19.17020 (proto.xml Berserk/Hirdman/ThrowingAxeman/Huskarl/Hersir/Godi <train> lists and Build protoaction rate Building 1.0, Repair Building 0.4 / AbstractWall 0.2; techtree.xml ArchaicAgeLoki WorkRate Build)
notes: Berserk (Archaic), Hersir (Archaic), Hirdman, Throwing Axeman (Classical), Huskarl, Godi (Heroic) place every Norse building except Farm and Ox Cart (also wall pieces and Titan Gate). Their Build rate is type 'Building', so they may help finish a Farm/Ox Cart foundation placed by a worker (not verified in game). Jarl and Raiding Cavalry cannot build. Dock build range 2.

notes: Free, no command: 2 Ravens appear at the first Temple. Every 180 s while a Temple exists and fewer than 2 Ravens live, 1 Raven is created at a Temple. Ravens are flying scouts, 0 pop, commands Patrol/Delete/Auto Scouting. 'raven' is not an id in norse.json. The OdinsRavens object added to the Wonder (AddDependentUnit) is decoration.

notes: When any ArmoryTechnology finishes (all 16 Dwarven Armory techs, including Hammer of Thunder and Dwarven Breastplate), 1 Dwarf appears at a Dwarven Armory. Not for techs granted automatically. Whether the Dwarf needs free pop room is not in the files.

source: Game files 19.17020 (proto.xml DwarvenArmory researchrate 0.33, cost Wood 135, buildpoints 40, <tech> list; techtree.xml ArchaicAgeThor Enable DwarvenArmory + TechStatus obtainable for every armory tech + ArmoryTechnology Cost x0.90 BasePercent; ClassicalAgeThor ResearchRate 0.67, HeroicAgeThor 0.5, MythicAgeThor 0.5 Absolute)
notes: Thor has no Armory. The Dwarven Armory (built by infantry/heroes from the Archaic Age) researches every armory tech in any age (ArchaicAgeThor makes them all obtainable; only chain prereqs such as Copper before Bronze apply). Research rate 0.33 / 1.0 / 1.5 / 2.0 by age; ArmoryTechnology costs x0.9 (food, wood, gold, favor). The researchTime effects are alternatives per age, not cumulative.

source: Game files 19.17020 (major_gods.xml civ Loki <bonusunitspawning><damagegoal name=LokiSpawn rewardtracking=Single>)
notes: Passive, no command. Damage dealt by Hersirs (x0.5), Godi (x0.15) and human soldiers (x0.15) to enemy units (not buildings, myth units or huntables) fills a meter; when it reaches the next myth unit's cost (food+wood+gold, favor x10) a random myth unit spawns at the damaged target. Candidate pool (age / minor-god rules), pop-room need and meter start are not in the files (unlike Shennong's goal, no agerestricted/archaicspawn flags). Combat-driven, so not schedulable in a build order.
